def transform2(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != bg for v in row)]
    if not active: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The task contains two vertically separated copies of a row pattern.
    gaps = [(active[i+1]-active[i], i) for i in range(len(active)-1)]
    if not gaps: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _, split_i = max(gaps)
    top, bottom = active[:split_i+1], active[split_i+1:]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if len(top) != len(bottom): return out
    for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom):
        def suffix(row):
            j=w-1
            if row[j] == bg: return (None,0)
            c=row[j]
            while j>=0 and row[j]==c: j-=1
            return c,w-1-j
        ca,na=suffix(grid[ra]); cb,nb=suffix(grid[rb])
        if ca is not None and na>=3 and (na>nb or cb!=ca):
            src,dst=ra,rb
        elif cb is not None and nb>=3 and (nb>na or ca!=cb):
            src,dst=rb,ra
        else: continue
        c,n=suffix(grid[src]); start=w-n
        for j in range(start,w):
            if out[dst][j]==bg and grid[src][j]==c:
                out[dst][j]=1
    return out

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != bg for v in row)]
    if not active: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _, split_i = max((active[i+1]-active[i], i) for i in range(len(active)-1))
    top, bottom = active[:split_i+1], active[split_i+1:]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if len(top) != len(bottom): return out
    def suffix(row):
        j=w-1
        if row[j] == bg: return None,0
        c=row[j]
        while j>=0 and row[j]==c: j-=1
        return c,w-1-j
    for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom):
        ca,na=suffix(grid[ra]); cb,nb=suffix(grid[rb])
        if ca is not None and na>=3 and (na>nb or cb!=ca): src,dst=ra,rb
        elif cb is not None and nb>=3 and (nb>na or ca!=cb): src,dst=rb,ra

        c,n=suffix(grid[src])
        occupied=[j for j,v in enumerate(grid[dst]) if v!=bg]
        start=max(occupied,default=-1)+1
        for j in range(start,w):
            if out[dst][j]==bg and grid[src][j]==c: out[dst][j]=1

def transform4(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if any(v!=bg for v in row)]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if len(active)<2:return out
    _,split=max((active[i+1]-active[i],i) for i in range(len(active)-1)); up,lo=active[:split+1],active[split+1:]
    if len(up)!=len(lo):return out
    scores=[]
    for d in range(-3,4):
        inter=union=0
        for a,b in zip(up,lo):
            for j in range(w):
                k=j+d
                if 0<=k<w:
                    x=grid[a][j]!=bg;y=grid[b][k]!=bg
                    inter+=x and y;union+=x or y
        scores.append((inter/union if union else 0,-abs(d),d))
    d=max(scores)[2]
    for a,b in zip(up,lo):
        enda=max((j for j,x in enumerate(grid[a]) if x!=bg),default=-1)
        endb=max((j for j,x in enumerate(grid[b]) if x!=bg),default=-1)
        # Map upper coordinates j to lower coordinates j+d.
        endb_aligned=endb-d
        if enda==w-1 and endb_aligned<enda:
            source,target,src_is_up,end = a,b,True,endb
        elif endb==w-1 and enda<endb_aligned:
            source,target,src_is_up,end = b,a,False,enda
        else: continue
        for t in range(end+1,w):
            s=t-d if src_is_up else t+d
            if 0<=s<w and out[target][t]==bg and grid[source][s]!=bg: out[target][t]=1
    return out,d
for name,demo in [('D1',D1),('D2',D2),('D3',D3),('D4',D4),('D5',D5),('D6',D6),('D7',D7),('D8',D8)]:
 o,d=transform4(demo);print(name,d,[(r,[j for j,x in enumerate(row) if x==1]) for r,row in enumerate(o) if 1 in row])
print('test',transform4(grid)[1],[(r,[j for j,x in enumerate(row) if x==1]) for r,row in enumerate(transform4(grid)[0]) if 1 in row])

program='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != background for v in row)]
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if len(active) < 2:
        return result

    _, split = max((active[i + 1] - active[i], i) for i in range(len(active) - 1))
    upper, lower = active[:split + 1], active[split + 1:]
    if len(upper) != len(lower):
        return result

    has_gapped_row = any(
        sum(value != background for value in grid[r]) >
        max((len(segment) for segment in ''.join(
            '1' if value != background else '0' for value in grid[r]
        ).split('0')), default=0)
        for r in upper + lower
    )
    offset = 0
    if has_gapped_row:
        scores = []
        for shift in range(-3, 4):
            intersection = union = 0
            for a, b in zip(upper, lower):
                for j in range(w):
                    k = j + shift
                    if 0 <= k < w:
                        first = grid[a][j] != background
                        second = grid[b][k] != background
                        intersection += first and second
                        union += first or second
            scores.append((intersection / union if union else 0, -abs(shift), shift))
        offset = max(scores)[2]

    for a, b in zip(upper, lower):
        end_a = max((j for j, value in enumerate(grid[a]) if value != background), default=-1)
        end_b = max((j for j, value in enumerate(grid[b]) if value != background), default=-1)
        end_b_aligned = end_b - offset
        if end_a == w - 1 and end_b_aligned < end_a:
            source, target, source_is_upper, end = a, b, True, end_b
        elif end_b == w - 1 and end_a < end_b_aligned:
            source, target, source_is_upper, end = b, a, False, end_a
        else:
            continue

        for target_col in range(end + 1, w):
            source_col = target_col - offset if source_is_upper else target_col + offset
            if (0 <= source_col < w and result[target][target_col] == background
                    and grid[source][source_col] != background):
                result[target][target_col] = 1
    return result
'''
